verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform. Its getting-started guide says that once a Sandbox API key is issued you can immediately start calling the APIs, and there are documented API references such as the Internal Transfer API and the Webhook API. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json and an llms.txt index, which makes the API easy for agents to consume. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
